note: Aquinas gives a case of a subject actively contributing to a perfection in itself, as opposed to merely receiving it from outside. To instantiate the route’s existential, identify an actual proper accident with a respect, its subject with the same bearer at both ends, and qualified active resultance with the route’s CausesIn for that respect.
